newsitem.title: USA: Hughes Missile nets $125 million contract.
newsitem.headline: Hughes Missile nets $125 million contract.

text.p: Hughes Missile Systems Co. said Tuesday the Army has awarded it two tactical missile contracts worth over $125 million.

The contract won by the Hughes Electronics Corp. unit covers the production of 1,299 Stinger reprogrammable microprocessor missiles, 334 launchers and support equipment and is primarily in support of the Taiwan Avenger-Stinger programme.
Work on the contracts will be done mainly in Tucson, Ariz., as well as New Mexico, Alabama and California, and is scheduled to be completed in June 2000.

Hughes Missiles is the world's leading producer of tactical missiles. Hughes Electronics is owned by General Motors Corp., and GM's H Class stock, which reflects the performance of Hughesm, was off 62.5 cents at $59.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
